cc_history_note: Collected samples only · up to 15 minutes · at most one sample per second. Gaps are retained; initial rates need a second sample.
cc_health_note: No capacity-health percentage, cycle count or lifetime estimate is inferred.
cc_no_battery: No accessible battery sample. Desktop batteries appear only when detected; Android requires the foreground platform bridge.
cc_no_network: Network counters unavailable or no active interface. Access denial and the first sample are never displayed as zero rates.
cc_no_disk: No accessible physical-device activity counters. Capacity remains available on the Storage page.
cc_no_sensors: No readable sensor values. Driver exposure and permissions vary; sensor names do not imply available measurements.
cc_process_note: Read-only process list · refreshed at most every 2 s while visible · CPU is a percentage of one logical core · up to 2048 processes sampled / 200 displayed. Restricted processes are omitted.
cc_process_unavailable: Process data is collecting, unavailable or restricted. Android limits access to other apps; Voltix's own CPU usage is shown on the CPU page.
cc_filter: Filter by process name or PID
cc_fps_note: Voltix does not measure another game's FPS or frametime. Configure MangoHud to collect those in the game.
cc_sensors_note: Linux: readable hwmon values. Android: available sensor inventory only; continuous sensor listeners are not enabled.
cc_android_limits: Android / SELinux can block system CPU, GPU utilization, clocks, temperature, power and dedicated VRAM. UMA memory is shared; no dedicated VRAM value is invented.
cc_permission_note: No dangerous runtime permissions are required. Battery, memory, display and sensor enumeration use platform APIs. Network details use ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE; document export uses Android's system picker.
cc_linux_diagnostics: Linux diagnostics · no permission changes are performed
cc_nvml_ok: NVIDIA NVML metrics are being reported.
cc_nvml_missing: No NVML metrics reported. If NVIDIA is expected, check the driver and libnvidia-ml.so.1; never change device permissions automatically.
cc_smart_note: Drive temperatures appear when hwmon exposes them. SMART health and UPS-specific data are not queried; these may need separate tools and permissions. Normal monitoring never requires root.
cc_export_note: Export the current telemetry snapshot as JSON, including unavailable states. Files can contain host, device, interface and process names. Choose a destination deliberately; no upload occurs.
cc_export_failed: Export failed; check destination access and available space
cc_export_choose: Choose the destination in Android's document picker
cc_export_path: Linux destination directory (a new uniquely named file is created)
cc_sensor_available: Listed by Android SensorManager · no live value requested
cc_android_fps_note: Other-game FPS / frametime is unavailable. Android has no universal MangoHud overlay.
cc_android_network_note: Android rates and totals cover all TrafficStats interfaces; the name identifies the active link, not a per-interface counter.
cc_network_aggregate: Network summary/history sums non-loopback interfaces; bridges and tunnels may count traffic more than once. Per-interface counters are listed below.
cc_app_settings_failed: Could not open Android application settings; open Voltix in system Settings manually.
proc_identity: PID + start ticks identify this process lifetime.
proc_gone: Process exited, is restricted, or is outside the sampled list. A reused PID will not be selected.
proc_pending: Waiting for details from the next process sample…
proc_note: Read-only · sampled every 2 s while visible · CPU: one logical core (may exceed 100%) · RSS: resident MiB · bars: one core / total RAM · high RAM: ≥256 MiB.
proc_limit: Sample limited to 2048 processes. Top consumers and filters refer to this sample.
proc_tasks_note: Kernel task count; may include host tasks in containers. Restricted process fields remain unavailable.
